vibe_rationale: Well-loved riverside night market with real Asian food culture and free entertainment, but mass and family-friendly rather than a curated subculture.
fit_notes: Broad Adelaide night market crowd with a family pull; no adult skew is recorded and wellness adjacency is weak. Free multi-week footfall in spring suits sampling or a hydration stall, but OzAsia is the 2026 presenter and the 2027 partner model is not yet known.
